matches: Minnesota Secretary Of State - Absentee Data
Data about absentee voting in Minnesota is listed below

This incorporates all voting before election day, including voter requests for an absentee ballot by mail, ballots sent to voters on the permanent absentee list, ballots sent to UOCAVA voters, ballots sent to voters in precincts that vote by mail, absentee in person voting (by envelope), and early voting
The data below lists counts of absentee applications and accepted ballots (by mail and in person) for the State General Election
